doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Mongo Santamaria and early recording sessions
title: Flute By-Laws and the Atlantic records
summary: Brown asks about Flute By-Laws with Chick Corea, Cachao, Richard Davis and Ron Carter. Laws counts his Atlantic albums.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Then the next one is Flute By-Laws. Again, Chick is back, but the bass player is Cachao.
Cachao didn’t play on every one. Cachao may have played on . . .
And then Richard Davis on the other session. This was the first session.

Yeah, Richard Davis played mostly, as I can recall. And then Ron Carter played on some of that stuff. He played on Laws’ Cause. Yeah, that’s who played on the last. I did three records for Atlantic. I did four altogether, but I did the fourth after I had already signed with CTI.
